description: This Java class defines a custom ELResolver (NodeELResolver) for resolving properties on XML DOM Nodes using XPath expressions. It handles Node and NodeImpl objects, evaluates XPath queries, and caches compiled expressions. The resolver is read-only and provides mechanisms for property type, value retrieval, and expression compilation.

classes.name: NodeELResolver
classes.description: A custom ELResolver for resolving properties on XML Nodes using XPath, supporting Node and NodeImpl objects, with caching and read-only enforcement.

methods.name: getCommonPropertyType
methods.description: Returns String.class if the base object is resolvable, otherwise null.

methods.name: getFeatureDescriptors
methods.description: Returns null; no feature descriptors provided.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns Node.class if the base is resolvable, sets property resolved to true.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Evaluates XPath expression on the Node base object, returns matching Node(s) or null.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating the resolver is read-only.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Throws PropertyNotWritableException, as the resolver is read-only.

methods.name: isResolvable
methods.description: Checks if the base object is a Node or NodeImpl.

methods.name: getXPathExpressionInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or compiles and caches XPathExpression for a given XPath string.
